svg.title: Work as the area under a force graph
svg.desc: (a) For a constant force component F cos θ acting over a distance d, the work W = Fd cos θ is the area of the rectangle under the graph. (b) For a varying force, the distance is split into small pieces di; each contributes Wi = (F cos θ)i(ave) di, and the total work W = ΣWi is the total area under the curve. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Work accumulates as signed area under F∥ versus x
The moving red cursor is displacement; shaded area is work, measured in joules.
